shortDescription: Module for setup of HealthMonitor Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: User defined description for the object.

options.name: dns_monitor
options.description: Healthmonitordns settings for healthmonitor.

options.name: external_monitor
options.description: Healthmonitorexternal settings for healthmonitor.

options.name: failed_checks
options.description: Number of continuous failed health checks before the server is marked down. Allowed values are 1-50. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.

options.name: http_monitor
options.description: Healthmonitorhttp settings for healthmonitor.

options.name: https_monitor
options.description: Healthmonitorhttp settings for healthmonitor.

options.name: is_federated
options.description: This field describes the object's replication scope. If the field is set to false, then the object is visible within the controller-cluster and its associated service-engines. If the field is set to true, then the object is replicated across the federation. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: monitor_port
options.description: Use this port instead of the port defined for the server in the pool. If the monitor succeeds to this port, the load balanced traffic will still be sent to the port of the server defined within the pool. Allowed values are 1-65535. Special values are 0 - 'use server port'.

options.name: name
options.description: A user friendly name for this health monitor.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: radius_monitor
options.description: Health monitor for radius. Field introduced in 18.2.3.

options.name: receive_timeout
options.description: A valid response from the server is expected within the receive timeout window. This timeout must be less than the send interval. If server status is regularly flapping up and down, consider increasing this value. Allowed values are 1-2400. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.

options.name: send_interval
options.description: Frequency, in seconds, that monitors are sent to a server. Allowed values are 1-3600. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10.

options.name: sip_monitor
options.description: Health monitor for sip. Field introduced in 17.2.8, 18.1.3, 18.2.1.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: successful_checks
options.description: Number of continuous successful health checks before server is marked up. Allowed values are 1-50. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.

options.name: tcp_monitor
options.description: Healthmonitortcp settings for healthmonitor.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the health monitor. Enum options - HEALTH_MONITOR_PING, HEALTH_MONITOR_TCP, HEALTH_MONITOR_HTTP, HEALTH_MONITOR_HTTPS, HEALTH_MONITOR_EXTERNAL, HEALTH_MONITOR_UDP, HEALTH_MONITOR_DNS, HEALTH_MONITOR_GSLB, HEALTH_MONITOR_SIP, HEALTH_MONITOR_RADIUS.

options.name: udp_monitor
options.description: Healthmonitorudp settings for healthmonitor.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the health monitor.
